tool_schemas.name: get_workspace_hierarchy
tool_schemas.description: Returns the workspace hierarchy (workspace → spaces → folders → lists) for the requested workspace, optionally including archived and/or deleted entities, resolved by internal workspaceId when provided or by ClickUp teamId otherwise. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither workspaceId nor teamId is provided or if workspaceId fails the expected format; raises NOT_FOUND if the referenced workspace/team cannot be resolved; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the workspace.

workspaceId.description: Internal workspace id (preferred) to fetch cached hierarchy for.

teamId.description: ClickUp team/workspace vendor id (clickup_team_id) to fetch hierarchy for when workspaceId is not provided.

includeArchived.description: Whether to include archived containers in the returned hierarchy.

includeDeleted.description: Whether to include deleted containers/tasks in the returned hierarchy.

tool_schemas.name: create_task
tool_schemas.description: Creates a single task in the destination list resolved by listId (preferred) or by listName within the workspace hierarchy, and returns the created task including any applied tags, assignees, dates, priority, parent linkage, and custom field values. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when name is missing, when neither listId nor listName is provided, when status is not a valid status for the destination list, or when customFields is not an array of {id,value}; raises NOT_FOUND if the destination list, parent task, assignee user, tag, or custom field id cannot be resolved; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller lacks permission to create tasks in the list.

listId.description: Internal container id of the destination list (preferred).

listName.description: Destination list name to resolve within the workspace hierarchy when listId is not provided.

status.description: Task status name to set (must exist in the destination list status options).

assigneeUserIds.description: Array of ClickUp user ids to assign to the task.

parent.description: Parent ClickUp task id/custom id to create this task as a subtask under.

tags.description: Array of tag names to apply to the task.

value.description: Value to set for the custom field.

customFields.description: Custom fields to set as array of {id, value}.

tool_schemas.name: get_task
tool_schemas.description: Returns full task details resolved by taskId (preferred; supports regular/custom IDs) or by taskName (optionally scoped by listName), and includes subtask details when subtasks=true. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither taskId nor taskName is provided, or if taskName lookup is ambiguous without enough scope; raises NOT_FOUND if the task cannot be found in the specified scope; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the task.

taskId.description: ClickUp task id or custom id to fetch (preferred).

taskName.description: Task name to search for when taskId is not provided.

listName.description: List name to scope taskName lookup for faster/safer matching.

subtasks.description: Whether to include full details for all subtasks.

tool_schemas.name: update_task
tool_schemas.description: Updates one or more mutable task properties for the task resolved by taskId (preferred) or by taskName (optionally scoped by listName) and returns the updated task. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if no update fields are provided, if neither taskId nor taskName is provided, if status is not valid for the task’s list, or if customFields is not an array of {id,value}; raises NOT_FOUND if the task (or referenced parent, assignee, tag, or custom field id) cannot be resolved; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller lacks permission to edit the task.

taskId.description: ClickUp task id or custom id to update (preferred).

taskName.description: Task name to search for when taskId is not provided.

listName.description: List name to scope taskName lookup and reduce ambiguity.

assigneeUserIds.description: Full set of ClickUp user ids to assign (replaces existing assignments).

parent.description: Parent ClickUp task id/custom id to set/move this task under.

tags.description: Full set of tag names to apply (replaces existing tags).

value.description: Value to set for the custom field.

customFields.description: Custom fields to update as array of {id, value}.

tool_schemas.name: move_task
tool_schemas.description: Moves an existing task (resolved by taskId or by taskName scoped by sourceListName) into a destination list resolved by listId (preferred) or listName, and returns the moved task in its new list. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required identifiers are missing (no task reference, no destination list, or missing sourceListName when moving by name) or if the taskName lookup is ambiguous; raises NOT_FOUND if the task, source list, or destination list cannot be resolved; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller lacks permission to move the task or create tasks in the destination list.

taskId.description: ClickUp task id or custom id to move (preferred).

taskName.description: Task name to search for when taskId is not provided.

sourceListName.description: Source list name to scope taskName lookup when moving by name.

listId.description: Internal container id of the destination list (preferred).

listName.description: Destination list name to resolve when listId is not provided.

tool_schemas.name: duplicate_task
tool_schemas.description: Creates a copy of an existing task resolved by taskId or by taskName scoped by sourceListName, optionally into a destination list resolved by listId/listName (defaulting to the source list), and returns the newly created duplicate task. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required identifiers are missing (no task reference, or missing sourceListName when duplicating by name) or if the taskName lookup is ambiguous; raises NOT_FOUND if the source task or specified destination list cannot be resolved; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller lacks permission to read the source task or create tasks in the destination list.

taskId.description: ClickUp task id or custom id to duplicate (preferred).

taskName.description: Task name to search for when taskId is not provided.

sourceListName.description: Source list name to scope taskName lookup when duplicating by name.

listId.description: Internal container id of the destination list (preferred); defaults to the source list.

listName.description: Destination list name to resolve when listId is not provided; defaults to the source list.

tool_schemas.name: delete_task
tool_schemas.description: Permanently deletes the task resolved by taskId (preferred) or by taskName (optionally scoped by listName) and returns a deletion confirmation. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither taskId nor taskName is provided or if taskName lookup is ambiguous without enough scope; raises NOT_FOUND if the task cannot be resolved; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller lacks permission to delete the task.

taskId.description: ClickUp task id or custom id to permanently delete (preferred/safest).

taskName.description: Task name to search for when taskId is not provided.

listName.description: List name to scope taskName lookup and reduce ambiguity.

tool_schemas.name: get_task_comments
tool_schemas.description: Lists comments for the task resolved by taskId (preferred) or by taskName (optionally scoped by listName), returning comments in pages using start (offset) and/or startId (cursor) to continue from a specific point. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither taskId nor taskName is provided or if taskName lookup is ambiguous, and if pagination parameters are invalid; raises NOT_FOUND if the task cannot be resolved; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the task comments.

taskId.description: ClickUp task id or custom id to fetch comments for (preferred).

taskName.description: Task name to search for when taskId is not provided.

listName.description: List name to scope taskName lookup and reduce ambiguity.

startId.description: Pagination cursor/comment id to start after for comments retrieval.

tool_schemas.name: create_task_comment
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new comment on the task resolved by taskId (preferred) or by taskName scoped by listName, and returns the created comment. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if commentText is missing, if neither taskId nor taskName is provided, or if taskName is used without listName; raises NOT_FOUND if the task cannot be resolved; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller lacks permission to comment on the task.

taskId.description: Internal task id to comment on (preferred).

taskName.description: Task name to resolve within the provided list scope when taskId is not supplied.

listName.description: List name used to scope taskName lookup.

notifyAll.description: Whether to notify all assignees/watchers for the task.

assignee.description: ClickUp user id to assign the comment to (vendor user id).

tool_schemas.name: attach_task_file
tool_schemas.description: Attaches file to task. Use taskId (preferred) or taskName + optional listName. File sources: 1) base64 + filename (≤10MB), 2) URL (http/https), 3) local path (absolute), 4) chunked for large files. WARNING: taskName without listName may match multiple tasks.

taskId.description: Internal task id to attach the file to (preferred).

taskName.description: Task name to resolve when taskId is not supplied.

listName.description: Optional list name to scope taskName lookup (recommended to avoid ambiguity).

filename.description: Filename to use for the attachment (required for base64; recommended otherwise).

url.description: HTTP/HTTPS URL to fetch and attach (use with sourceType=url).

localPath.description: Absolute local filesystem path to attach (use with sourceType=local_path).

uploadId.description: Identifier of a previously prepared chunked upload.

partCount.description: Total number of parts expected for the chunked upload.

chunked.description: Chunked upload reference for large files (use with sourceType=chunked).

tool_schemas.name: create_bulk_tasks
tool_schemas.description: Creates multiple tasks in a single target List (resolved by listId, or by listName when listId is omitted) and returns the created task records for each input item; execution may be split into batches and run concurrently according to options, but results are not cursor-paged. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if tasks is empty, any task is missing name, customFields items are not {id,value}, or options.batchSize/options.concurrency are < 1; raises NOT_FOUND if the target List cannot be resolved, and CONFLICT if a referenced parentClickupTaskId does not exist or cannot accept subtasks or if statusName is not valid for the destination List. Raises FORBIDDEN if you do not have permission to create tasks in the target List and RATE_LIMITED when bulk execution exceeds allowed request/operation limits.

listId.description: Internal list container id to create tasks in (preferred).

listName.description: List name to resolve the target list when listId is not supplied.

statusName.description: Status name to set on the task.

assigneeUserIds.description: Array of ClickUp user ids to assign (vendor user ids).

tags.description: Array of tag names to apply.

parentClickupTaskId.description: Vendor ClickUp parent task id for creating a subtask.

customFields.description: Custom fields as an array of {id, value}.

tasks.description: Array of tasks to create (each task requires name).

batchSize.description: Number of tasks per batch request.

concurrency.description: Maximum number of concurrent batch operations.

options.description: Bulk execution options for batching and concurrency.

tool_schemas.name: update_bulk_tasks
tool_schemas.description: Updates multiple tasks efficiently. For each task: use taskId (preferred) or taskName + listName. At least one update field per task. Configure batch size/concurrency via options. WARNING: taskName without listName will fail.

taskName.description: Task name to resolve when taskId is not supplied.

listName.description: List name used to scope taskName lookup (required when using taskName).

assigneeUserIds.description: New full list of assignee ClickUp user ids (vendor user ids).

tags.description: New full list of tag names.

parentClickupTaskId.description: New vendor ClickUp parent task id.

customFields.description: Custom fields to set as an array of {id, value}.

update.description: Fields to update for this task (must include at least one field).

batchSize.description: Number of tasks per batch request.

concurrency.description: Maximum number of concurrent batch operations.

options.description: Bulk execution options for batching and concurrency.

tool_schemas.name: move_bulk_tasks
tool_schemas.description: Moves multiple tasks into a single target List (resolved by targetListId, or by targetListName when targetListId is omitted) and returns the updated task records; work is performed in batches/concurrently per options and is not cursor-paged. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if tasks is empty, any task reference is missing both taskId and (taskName + listName), or options.batchSize/options.concurrency are < 1; raises NOT_FOUND if the target List cannot be resolved, or if any referenced task (by id or by name within listName) does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if you lack permission to move any task or write to the target List, CONFLICT if the move is not allowed for the task’s current state, and RATE_LIMITED when bulk execution exceeds allowed limits.

targetListId.description: Internal list container id to move tasks into (preferred).

targetListName.description: List name to resolve the target list when targetListId is not supplied.

taskName.description: Task name to resolve when taskId is not supplied.

listName.description: List name used to scope taskName lookup (required when using taskName).

batchSize.description: Number of tasks per batch request.

concurrency.description: Maximum number of concurrent batch operations.

options.description: Bulk execution options for batching and concurrency.

tool_schemas.name: delete_bulk_tasks
tool_schemas.description: Permanently deletes multiple tasks and returns a per-item deletion result; deletions may be executed in batches and concurrently per options and are not cursor-paged. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if tasks is empty, any task reference is missing both taskId and (taskName + listName), or options.batchSize/options.concurrency are < 1; raises NOT_FOUND if any referenced task (by id or by name within listName) cannot be resolved. Raises FORBIDDEN if you do not have permission to delete a task, CONFLICT if the task cannot be deleted in its current state, and RATE_LIMITED when bulk execution exceeds allowed limits.

taskName.description: Task name to resolve when taskId is not supplied.

listName.description: List name used to scope taskName lookup (required when using taskName).

tasks.description: Array of tasks to permanently delete.

batchSize.description: Number of tasks per batch request.

concurrency.description: Maximum number of concurrent batch operations.

options.description: Bulk execution options for batching and concurrency.

tool_schemas.name: get_workspace_tasks
tool_schemas.description: Purpose: Retrieve tasks from across the entire workspace with powerful filtering options, including tag-based filtering. Valid Usage: 1. Apply any combination of filters (tags, lists, folders, spaces, statuses, etc.) 2. Use pagination to manage large result sets Requirements: - At least one filter parameter is REQUIRED (tags, list_ids, folder_ids, space_ids, statuses, assignees, or date filters) - Pagination parameters (page, order_by, reverse) alone are not considered filters Notes: - Provides workspace-wide task access (unlike get_tasks which only searches in one list) - Returns complete task details including descriptions, assignees, custom fields, and all metadata - Tag filtering is especially useful for cross-list organization (e.g., "project-x", "blocker", "needs-review") - Combine multiple filters to narrow down your search scope - Use pagination for large result sets - Use the detail_level parameter to control the amount of data returned: - "summary": Returns lightweight task data (name, status, list, tags) - "detailed": Returns complete task data with all fields (DEFAULT if not specified) - Responses exceeding 50,000 tokens automatically switch to summary format to avoid hitting LLM token limits

workspaceId.description: Internal workspace id to query tasks from.

tags.description: Filter to tasks that have any of these tag names.

listIds.description: Filter by internal list container ids.

folderIds.description: Filter by internal folder container ids.

spaceIds.description: Filter by internal space container ids.

assignees.description: Filter by assignee ClickUp user ids (vendor user ids).

dueFrom.description: Filter to tasks with due_date on/after this timestamp.

dueTo.description: Filter to tasks with due_date on/before this timestamp.

startFrom.description: Filter to tasks with start_date on/after this timestamp.

startTo.description: Filter to tasks with start_date on/before this timestamp.

updatedFrom.description: Filter to tasks updated_at on/after this timestamp.

updatedTo.description: Filter to tasks updated_at on/before this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get_task_time_entries
tool_schemas.description: Lists time entries for a task (resolved by taskId, or by taskName optionally scoped by listName) and returns entries including user info, description, tags, start/end times, and duration; results are paged with limit and cursor, and you can request the next page by supplying the returned cursor. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid date ranges (e.g., startFrom after startTo) or limit < 1; raises NOT_FOUND if the task cannot be resolved. Raises FORBIDDEN if you lack permission to view the task or its time tracking data and RATE_LIMITED if requests exceed quota.

taskId.description: Internal task id to fetch time entries for (preferred).

taskName.description: Task name to resolve when taskId is not supplied.

listName.description: Optional list name to scope taskName lookup.

userId.description: Filter time entries to a specific ClickUp user id (vendor user id).

startFrom.description: Filter to entries with start_time on/after this timestamp.

startTo.description: Filter to entries with start_time on/before this timestamp.

tags.description: Filter to entries that have any of these tag names.

limit.description: Maximum number of time entries to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: start_time_tracking
tool_schemas.description: Starts a running time entry for a task (resolved by task_id, or by task_name optionally scoped by list_name) and returns the created running time entry with its current start time and metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither a task id nor a resolvable task name is provided; raises NOT_FOUND if the task cannot be resolved. Raises CONFLICT if a timer is already running, FORBIDDEN if you lack permission to track time on the task, and RATE_LIMITED if you exceed allowed request limits.

task_id.description: Internal task id to start tracking on (preferred).

task_name.description: Task name to resolve within the provided scope when task_id is not given.

list_name.description: Optional list name used to disambiguate task_name resolution.

description.description: Optional description for the running time entry.

billable.description: Whether the time entry is billable.

tags.description: Optional list of tag names to apply to the time entry.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def start_time_tracking(task_id=None, task_name=None, list_name=None, description=None, billable=None, tags=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, re
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0497000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0497000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    endpoint = "start_time_tracking"

    def _now_iso():
        return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()

    def _parse_dt(s):
        if not isinstance(s, str) or not s:
            return None
        try:
            if s.endswith("Z"):
                s = s[:-1] + "+00:00"
            return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(s)
        except Exception:
            return None

    def _to_iso(dt):
        if isinstance(dt, str):
            d = _parse_dt(dt)
            return d.isoformat() if d else None
        if isinstance(dt, datetime.datetime):
            if dt.tzinfo is None:
                dt = dt.replace(tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
            return dt.astimezone(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
        return None

    def _gen_id(prefix, rows, key):
        # cu_ent_ + 20 chars base32ish
        alphabet = "0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
        def _rand(n):
            # deterministic-ish from time; sufficient for offline store
            seed = int(time.time() * 1000000)
            out = []
            for i in range(n):
                seed = (1103515245 * seed + 12345) & 0x7fffffff
                out.append(alphabet[seed % len(alphabet)])
            return "".join(out)
        while True:
            cand = f"{prefix}{_rand(20)}"
            if all(r.get(key) != cand for r in rows):
                return cand

    def _log(status, workspace_id=None, entity_id=None, extra=None):
        logs = _load("request_log.json")
        if not isinstance(logs, list):
            logs = []
        row = {
            "request_id": _gen_id("req_", logs, "request_id"),
            "endpoint": endpoint,
            "timestamp": _now_iso(),
            "status": status,
            "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
            "workspace_id": workspace_id,
            "entity_id": entity_id
        }
        if isinstance(extra, dict):
            row.update(extra)
        logs.append(row)
        _save("request_log.json", logs)

        # very lightweight rate limit: 120 requests / rolling 60s across all calls
        cutoff = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc) - datetime.timedelta(seconds=60)
        recent = 0
        for r in reversed(logs):
            ts = _parse_dt(r.get("timestamp"))
            if not ts:
                continue
            if ts < cutoff:
                break
            recent += 1
        return recent

    def _rate_limit_check():
        logs = _load("request_log.json")
        if not isinstance(logs, list):
            return None
        cutoff = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc) - datetime.timedelta(seconds=60)
        recent = 0
        for r in reversed(logs):
            ts = _parse_dt(r.get("timestamp"))
            if not ts:
                continue
            if ts < cutoff:
                break
            recent += 1
        if recent >= 120:
            return _err("RATE_LIMIT", "Rate limit exceeded. Please retry later.", limit=120, window_seconds=60)
        return None

    rl = _rate_limit_check()
    if rl:
        _log("error", extra={"error_code": rl["error"]["code"]})
        return rl

    # Validate inputs
    if task_id is None and (task_name is None or not isinstance(task_name, str) or not task_name.strip()):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Either task_id or a resolvable task_name must be provided.")
        _log("error", extra={"error_code": e["error"]["code"]})
        return e
    if task_id is not None:
        if not isinstance(task_id, str) or not re.match(r"^cu_tsk_[0-9A-Z]{18,}$", task_id):
            e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "task_id must match pattern ^cu_tsk_[0-9A-Z]{18,}$.")
            _log("error", extra={"error_code": e["error"]["code"]})
            return e
    if task_name is not None and (not isinstance(task_name, str) or not task_name.strip()):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "task_name must be a non-empty string when provided.")
        _log("error", extra={"error_code": e["error"]["code"]})
        return e
    if list_name is not None and (not isinstance(list_name, str) or not list_name.strip()):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "list_name must be a non-empty string when provided.")
        _log("error", extra={"error_code": e["error"]["code"]})
        return e
    if description is not None and not isinstance(description, str):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "description must be a string when provided.")
        _log("error", extra={"error_code": e["error"]["code"]})
        return e
    if billable is not None and not isinstance(billable, bool):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "billable must be a boolean when provided.")
        _log("error", extra={"error_code": e["error"]["code"]})
        return e
    if tags is not None:
        if not isinstance(tags, list) or any((not isinstance(x, str) or not x.strip()) for x in tags):
            e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "tags must be an array of non-empty strings when provided.")
            _log("error", extra={"error_code": e["error"]["code"]})
            return e

    workspaces = _load("workspaces.json")
    tasks = _load("tasks.json")
    containers = _load("containers.json")
    entities = _load("time_and_docs.json")

    if not isinstance(workspaces, list) or not isinstance(tasks, list) or not isinstance(containers, list) or not isinstance(entities, list):
        e = _err("CONFLICT", "Datastore is not initialized correctly.")
        _log("error", extra={"error_code": e["error"]["code"]})
        return e

    # Choose an active workspace that can serve request (ambient auth)
    active_ws_ids = {w.get("workspace_id") for w in workspaces if w.get("status") == "active" and w.get("workspace_id")}
    if not active_ws_ids:
        e = _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "No active workspace is available to serve this request.")
        _log("error", extra={"error_code": e["error"]["code"]})
        return e

    # Resolve task
    resolved_task = None
    if task_id is not None:
        for t in tasks:
            if t.get("task_id") == task_id and t.get("status") != "deleted" and t.get("workspace_id") in active_ws_ids:
                resolved_task = t
                break
        if not resolved_task:
            e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "Task not found.", task_id=task_id)
            _log("error", extra={"error_code": e["error"]["code"]})
            return e
    else:
        # Resolve by name with disambiguation rules
        name = task_name.strip()
        candidates = [t for t in tasks if t.get("status") != "deleted" and t.get("workspace_id") in active_ws_ids and t.get("name") == name]
        if list_name is not None:
            ln = list_name.strip()
            # resolve list container(s) by name within candidate workspaces
            list_ids_by_ws = {}
            for c in containers:
                if c.get("status") != "deleted" and c.get("type") == "LIST" and c.get("name") == ln and c.get("workspace_id") in active_ws_ids:
                    list_ids_by_ws.setdefault(c.get("workspace_id"), set()).add(c.get("container_id"))
            scoped = []
            for t in candidates:
                wsid = t.get("workspace_id")
                if wsid in list_ids_by_ws and t.get("list_container_id") in list_ids_by_ws[wsid]:
                    scoped.append(t)
            candidates = scoped
        else:
            # require disambiguating scope if multiple matches
            if len(candidates) > 1:
                e = _err("CONFLICT", "Multiple tasks match task_name. Provide list_name to disambiguate.", matches=len(candidates))
                _log("error", extra={"error_code": e["error"]["code"]})
                return e

        if not candidates:
            e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "Task not found for given name/scope.", task_name=task_name, list_name=list_name)
            _log("error", extra={"error_code": e["error"]["code"]})
            return e
        if len(candidates) > 1:
            e = _err("CONFLICT", "Multiple tasks match task_name within the provided scope.", matches=len(candidates))
            _log("error", extra={"error_code": e["error"]["code"]})
            return e
        resolved_task = candidates[0]

    workspace_id = resolved_task.get("workspace_id")

    # Enforce single running timer per (workspace_id, clickup_user_id): we don't have a user context parameter.
    # Use the RUNNING_TIMER_POINTER row (if any) to find/attribute current user; otherwise create a server pointer.
    pointer = None
    for e in entities:
        if e.get("workspace_id") == workspace_id and e.get("type") == "RUNNING_TIMER_POINTER" and e.get("status") != "deleted":
            pointer = e
            break
    clickup_user_id = pointer.get("clickup_user_id") if pointer else None
    # If no user id available, treat as server-level user "server"
    if not clickup_user_id:
        clickup_user_id = "server"

    # Find existing running entry for this user/workspace
    running = None
    for e in entities:
        if e.get("type") == "TIME_ENTRY" and e.get("workspace_id") == workspace_id and e.get("clickup_user_id") == clickup_user_id and e.get("status") == "running":
            running = e
            break
    if running:
        # Configuration: fail with CONFLICT (as tool description suggests)
        e = _err("CONFLICT", "A timer is already running for this user in this workspace.", running_time_entry_id=running.get("entity_id"))
        _log("error", workspace_id=workspace_id, entity_id=running.get("entity_id"), extra={"error_code": e["error"]["code"]})
        return e

    # Create running time entry
    now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
    entity_id = _gen_id("cu_ent_", entities, "entity_id")
    new_row = {
        "entity_id": entity_id,
        "workspace_id": workspace_id,
        "type": "TIME_ENTRY",
        "task_id": resolved_task.get("task_id"),
        "clickup_task_id": resolved_task.get("clickup_task_id"),
        "clickup_time_entry_id": None,
        "start_time": _to_iso(now),
        "end_time": None,
        "duration_seconds": None,
        "billable": billable if billable is not None else None,
        "description": description if description is not None else None,
        "tags": list(tags) if isinstance(tags, list) else None,
        "clickup_user_id": clickup_user_id,
        "document_id": None,
        "clickup_document_id": None,
        "clickup_page_id": None,
        "title": None,
        "content": None,
        "content_format": None,
        "parent_container_id": None,
        "parent_type_code": None,
        "visibility": None,
        "create_page": None,
        "depth": None,
        "status": "running",
        "created_at": _now_iso(),
        "updated_at": _now_iso()
    }

    # Validate required constraints for TIME_ENTRY + running
    if not new_row.get("start_time"):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "start_time is required for running time entry.")
        _log("error", workspace_id=workspace_id, extra={"error_code": e["error"]["code"]})
        return e

    entities.append(new_row)

    # Ensure pointer exists/updated
    if not pointer:
        pid = _gen_id("cu_ent_", entities, "entity_id")
        pointer = {
            "entity_id": pid,
            "workspace_id": workspace_id,
            "type": "RUNNING_TIMER_POINTER",
            "task_id": None,
            "clickup_task_id": None,
            "clickup_time_entry_id": None,
            "start_time": None,
            "end_time": None,
            "duration_seconds": None,
            "billable": None,
            "description": None,
            "tags": None,
            "clickup_user_id": clickup_user_id,
            "document_id": None,
            "clickup_document_id": None,
            "clickup_page_id": None,
            "title": None,
            "content": None,
            "content_format": None,
            "parent_container_id": None,
            "parent_type_code": None,
            "visibility": None,
            "create_page": None,
            "depth": None,
            "status": "active",
            "created_at": _now_iso(),
            "updated_at": _now_iso()
        }
        entities.append(pointer)
    else:
        pointer["clickup_user_id"] = clickup_user_id
        pointer["updated_at"] = _now_iso()

    _save("time_and_docs.json", entities)
    _log("ok", workspace_id=workspace_id, entity_id=entity_id)

    return {
        "time_entry": new_row,
        "task": {"task_id": resolved_task.get("task_id"), "clickup_task_id": resolved_task.get("clickup_task_id"), "name": resolved_task.get("name")},
        "meta": {"workspace_id": workspace_id}
    }

tool_schemas.name: stop_time_tracking
tool_schemas.description: Stops the currently running timer and returns the completed time entry, applying description/tags if provided. Raises NOT_FOUND if there is no running timer to stop. Raises FORBIDDEN if you are not allowed to stop the active timer (e.g., insufficient permissions) and RATE_LIMITED if you exceed allowed request limits.

description.description: Optional description to set/overwrite on the completed time entry.

tags.description: Optional list of tag names to set/overwrite on the completed time entry.

tool_schemas.name: add_time_entry
tool_schemas.description: Adds a manual (non-running) time entry to a task (resolved by task_id, or by task_name optionally scoped by list_name) and returns the created time entry record with start time, duration, and any provided metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required timing fields are missing or invalid (e.g., non-positive duration) or if neither a task id nor a resolvable task name is provided; raises NOT_FOUND if the task cannot be resolved. Raises FORBIDDEN if you lack permission to add time entries to the task and RATE_LIMITED if you exceed allowed request limits.

task_id.description: Internal task id to attach the time entry to (preferred).

task_name.description: Task name to resolve within the provided scope when task_id is not given.

list_name.description: Optional list name used to disambiguate task_name resolution.

start_time.description: Start time of the manual time entry (ISO 8601).

duration_seconds.description: Duration of the time entry in seconds.

description.description: Optional description for the time entry.

billable.description: Whether the time entry is billable.

tags.description: Optional list of tag names to apply to the time entry.

tool_schemas.name: delete_time_entry
tool_schemas.description: Deletes a time entry. Required: time entry ID.

time_entry_id.description: Internal time entry entity id to delete.

tool_schemas.name: get_current_time_entry
tool_schemas.description: Gets the currently running time entry, if any. No parameters needed.

tool_schemas.name: create_list
tool_schemas.description: Creates a list in a ClickUp space. Use spaceId (preferred) or spaceName + list name. Name is required. For lists in folders, use create_list_in_folder. Optional: content, dueDate, priority, assignee, status.

space_id.description: Internal container id of the SPACE to create the list in (preferred).

space_name.description: Space name to resolve within the workspace when space_id is not given.

name.description: Name of the list to create.

due_date.description: Optional due date for the list (ISO 8601).

priority.description: Optional priority value for the list.

assignee_user_id.description: Optional ClickUp user id to assign as the list assignee.

status.description: Optional initial status name for the list.

tool_schemas.name: create_list_in_folder
tool_schemas.description: Create a new List inside a Folder and return the created list record (including its id, name, content/description, and container/space metadata). You must provide `name` and either `folder_id` or (`folder_name` plus `space_id` or `space_name`) so we can uniquely resolve the destination folder; if both id and name are provided, the id is used. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing or inconsistent (e.g., `folder_name` without a space scope), NOT_FOUND when the target folder/space cannot be resolved, CONFLICT when the folder name resolution is ambiguous or a list with the same name already exists in the resolved folder, and FORBIDDEN when you don’t have access to the destination container.

folder_id.description: Internal container id of the FOLDER to create the list in (preferred).

folder_name.description: Folder name to resolve when folder_id is not given (requires space_id or space_name).

space_id.description: Internal container id of the SPACE used to scope folder_name resolution.

space_name.description: Space name used to scope folder_name resolution when space_id is not given.

name.description: Name of the list to create.

status.description: Optional initial status name for the list.

tool_schemas.name: get_list
tool_schemas.description: Fetch a single List by `list_id` (preferred) or by `list_name` and return its details (id, name, content/description, status, and container/space metadata). When resolving by name, we return the uniquely matched list; if multiple lists share the name, the request is refused. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when neither identifier is provided, NOT_FOUND when no matching list exists, CONFLICT when `list_name` matches multiple lists, and FORBIDDEN when you don’t have permission to view the list.

list_id.description: Internal container id of the LIST to fetch (preferred).

list_name.description: List name to resolve when list_id is not given.

tool_schemas.name: update_list
tool_schemas.description: Update an existing List identified by `listId` (preferred) or by `listName` resolved within an optional folder/space scope, and return the updated list; only fields you provide (`name`, `content`, `status`) are changed. The request requires at least one updatable field and, when using `listName`, enough scope (`folderId`/`folderName` or `spaceId`/`spaceName`) to resolve it unambiguously. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when no identifier or no update fields are provided or when `status` is not one of the allowed values, NOT_FOUND when the list (or scoping container) cannot be resolved, CONFLICT when name resolution is ambiguous or renaming would duplicate another list name in the same parent, and FORBIDDEN when you lack edit permission.

listId.description: Internal list container id (preferred) for the list to update.

listName.description: List name to resolve when listId is not provided (may be non-unique).

folderId.description: Folder container id to scope listName resolution (optional but recommended when using listName).

folderName.description: Folder name to scope listName resolution when folderId is not provided.

spaceId.description: Space container id to scope listName resolution when folder is not used/known.

spaceName.description: Space name to scope listName resolution when spaceId is not provided.

name.description: New list name (only updated if provided).

content.description: New list description/content (only updated if provided).

status.description: Internal record status for the list (only updated if provided).

tool_schemas.name: delete_list
tool_schemas.description: Permanently delete a List (and all tasks it contains) identified by `listId` (preferred) or by `listName` resolved within an optional folder/space scope, returning a deletion confirmation for the list id. If `listName` is used, we require enough scope to uniquely resolve the list and we refuse ambiguous matches to prevent accidental deletion. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when no identifier is provided or the scope is inconsistent, NOT_FOUND when the list cannot be found, CONFLICT when `listName` matches multiple lists, and FORBIDDEN when you don’t have permission to delete the list.

listId.description: Internal list container id (preferred) of the list to permanently delete.

listName.description: List name to resolve when listId is not provided (may be non-unique; risky).

folderId.description: Folder container id to scope listName resolution (optional but recommended when using listName).

folderName.description: Folder name to scope listName resolution when folderId is not provided.

spaceId.description: Space container id to scope listName resolution when folder is not used/known.

spaceName.description: Space name to scope listName resolution when spaceId is not provided.

tool_schemas.name: create_folder
tool_schemas.description: Create a Folder inside a Space and return the created folder record (including its id, name, and any configured override statuses). You must provide `name` and either `spaceId` or `spaceName`; if `override_statuses` is provided it is stored as the folder’s status override configuration. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing or `override_statuses` is not in the expected shape, NOT_FOUND when the target space cannot be resolved, CONFLICT when a folder with the same name already exists in the resolved space, and FORBIDDEN when you don’t have access to create folders in that space.

spaceId.description: Internal space container id (preferred) where the folder will be created.

spaceName.description: Space name to resolve the target space when spaceId is not provided.

override_statuses.description: Optional folder-specific status definitions that override inherited statuses.

tool_schemas.name: get_folder
tool_schemas.description: Fetch a single Folder by `folderId` (preferred) or by `folderName` scoped by `spaceId`/`spaceName`, and return its details (id, name, space metadata, and override status configuration if present). Name-based lookup must be uniquely resolvable within the provided space scope. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when neither identifier is provided or when `folderName` is provided without a space scope, NOT_FOUND when no matching folder exists, CONFLICT when `folderName` matches multiple folders in scope, and FORBIDDEN when you don’t have permission to view the folder.

folderId.description: Internal folder container id (preferred) to fetch.

folderName.description: Folder name to resolve when folderId is not provided (may be non-unique).

spaceId.description: Internal space container id to scope folderName resolution (recommended when using folderName).

spaceName.description: Space name to scope folderName resolution when spaceId is not provided.

tool_schemas.name: update_folder
tool_schemas.description: Update an existing Folder identified by `folderId` (preferred) or by `folderName` scoped by `spaceId`/`spaceName`, and return the updated folder; only provided fields (`name`, `override_statuses`) are changed. The request must include at least one update field and, for name-based resolution, enough scope to resolve the folder unambiguously. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when no identifier or no update fields are provided or when `override_statuses` is invalid, NOT_FOUND when the folder (or scoping space) cannot be resolved, CONFLICT when name resolution is ambiguous or renaming would duplicate another folder name in the same space, and FORBIDDEN when you lack permission to edit the folder.

folderId.description: Internal folder container id (preferred) for the folder to update.

folderName.description: Folder name to resolve when folderId is not provided (may be non-unique).

spaceId.description: Internal space container id to scope folderName resolution when using folderName.

spaceName.description: Space name to scope folderName resolution when spaceId is not provided.

name.description: New folder name (only updated if provided).

override_statuses.description: New override statuses for the folder (only updated if provided).

tool_schemas.name: delete_folder
tool_schemas.description: Permanently delete a Folder and everything inside it (lists and tasks), identified by `folderId` (preferred) or by `folderName` scoped by `spaceId`/`spaceName`, returning a deletion confirmation for the folder id. To prevent accidental deletion, we refuse name-based deletes that cannot be resolved uniquely within the provided space scope. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when no identifier is provided or when `folderName` is provided without a space scope, NOT_FOUND when the folder cannot be found, CONFLICT when `folderName` matches multiple folders in scope, and FORBIDDEN when you don’t have permission to delete the folder.

folderId.description: Internal folder container id (preferred) of the folder to permanently delete.

folderName.description: Folder name to resolve when folderId is not provided (may be non-unique; risky).

spaceId.description: Internal space container id to scope folderName resolution when using folderName.

spaceName.description: Space name to scope folderName resolution when spaceId is not provided.

tool_schemas.name: get_space_tags
tool_schemas.description: List all tags defined in a Space identified by `spaceId` (preferred) or `spaceName`, returning the full tag collection for that space. This endpoint returns the complete set in a single response (no pagination). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when no space identifier is provided, NOT_FOUND when the space cannot be resolved, and FORBIDDEN when you don’t have permission to view the space’s tags.

spaceId.description: Internal space container id (preferred) whose tags will be listed.

spaceName.description: Space name to resolve the target space when spaceId is not provided.

tool_schemas.name: add_tag_to_task
tool_schemas.description: Adds existing tag to task. Use taskId (preferred) or taskName + optional listName. Tag must exist in space (use get_space_tags to verify, create_space_tag if needed). WARNING: Will fail if tag doesn't exist.

taskId.description: Internal task id (preferred) to add the tag to.

taskName.description: Task name to resolve when taskId is not provided (may be non-unique).

listId.description: Internal list container id to scope taskName resolution (recommended when using taskName).

listName.description: List name to scope taskName resolution when listId is not provided.

tagName.description: Existing space tag name to add to the task (must already exist).

tool_schemas.name: remove_tag_from_task
tool_schemas.description: Removes tag from task. Use taskId (preferred) or taskName + optional listName. Only removes tag-task association, tag remains in space. For multiple tasks, provide listName to disambiguate.

workspaceId.description: Internal workspace id containing the task.

taskId.description: Internal task id to remove the tag from (preferred).

taskName.description: Task name to match when taskId is not provided.

listName.description: Optional list name scope to disambiguate tasks with the same name.

tagName.description: Name of the tag to remove from the task.

tool_schemas.name: get_workspace_members
tool_schemas.description: Returns the full set of workspace members (users) for the given workspaceId, optionally refreshing the cached roster when forceRefresh=true, and returns the members as an array (no pagination). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspaceId is missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist, FORBIDDEN if your integration is not authorized to view members for that workspace, and RATE_LIMITED if member refreshes/reads exceed allowed limits.

workspaceId.description: Internal workspace id to return members for.

forceRefresh.description: If true, refreshes the cached member list from ClickUp before returning.

tool_schemas.name: find_member_by_name
tool_schemas.description: Finds a member in the ClickUp workspace by name or email. Returns the member object if found, or null if not found.

workspaceId.description: Internal workspace id to search within.

query.description: Member name or email to match (case-insensitive).

tool_schemas.name: resolve_assignees
tool_schemas.description: Resolves an array of assignee names or emails to ClickUp user IDs. Returns an array of user IDs, or errors for any that cannot be resolved.

workspaceId.description: Internal workspace id to resolve users within.

assignees.description: Array of assignee names and/or emails to resolve to ClickUp user IDs.

tool_schemas.name: create_document
tool_schemas.description: Creates a ClickUp Doc in the specified parent container (SPACE/FOLDER/LIST/EVERYTHING/WORKSPACE) within workspaceId and returns the created document record, including its resolved parent and visibility. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, parent.type is not one of the supported codes, or parent.id/name is invalid for the chosen type; NOT_FOUND if the workspace or parent container does not exist; FORBIDDEN if you lack permission to create docs in that parent or the requested visibility is not allowed; and CONFLICT if a document with the same name already exists in the same parent scope (when uniqueness is enforced) or if the parent container cannot accept documents.

workspaceId.description: Internal workspace id to create the document in.

id.description: Parent container identifier (ClickUp container id for SPACE/FOLDER/LIST, or team id for WORKSPACE).

parent.description: Parent container information for where the document will live.

createPage.description: If true, creates an initial page in the document.

tool_schemas.name: get_document
tool_schemas.description: Returns a single document’s details from the workspace, resolved either by documentId (preferred) or by searching for title within the provided parentType/parentId scope, and returns the matching document record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither a valid documentId nor a resolvable (title + parentType + parentId) scope is provided; NOT_FOUND if no document matches the requested identifier/scope; CONFLICT if title-based lookup matches more than one document in the scope; and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to read documents in that workspace/container.

workspaceId.description: Internal workspace id containing the document.

title.description: Document title to search for when documentId is not provided.

parentType.description: Container type to scope title search.

parentId.description: Container id to scope title search (internal container id).

tool_schemas.name: list_documents
tool_schemas.description: Lists documents in the workspace, optionally filtered by parentType and/or parentId, sorted by the requested field and order, and returns a paged result set of up to limit documents plus a cursor when more results are available (omit cursor to start). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if limit is out of range, cursor is malformed, parentType is unsupported, or parentId is provided without a compatible scope; NOT_FOUND if the workspace (or specified parent container) does not exist; FORBIDDEN if you lack permission to list documents in the workspace/container; and RATE_LIMITED when listing exceeds allowed request quotas.

workspaceId.description: Internal workspace id to list documents for.

parentType.description: Optional parent type filter (accepts SPACE, FOLDER, LIST, EVERYTHING, WORKSPACE; case-insensitive in the backend).

parentId.description: Optional parent container id to filter documents by (internal container id).

limit.description: Maximum number of documents to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

order.description: Sort order for the sort field.

tool_schemas.name: list_document_pages
tool_schemas.description: Lists the page tree for a documentId in the workspace and returns all matching pages, optionally limited to the requested nesting depth (0 returns only top-level pages), with no pagination. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspaceId/documentId are missing/invalid or depth is negative; NOT_FOUND if the workspace or document does not exist; and FORBIDDEN if you do not have access to the document’s pages.

workspaceId.description: Internal workspace id containing the document.

documentId.description: Internal document entity id to list pages for.

depth.description: Optional nesting depth to return (0 for only top-level pages).

tool_schemas.name: get_document_pages
tool_schemas.description: Returns page content for a document, resolved by document_id or clickup_document_id; if page_ids is provided we return those pages, otherwise we return pages up to limit and include cursor when more pages are available, with optional depth applied when listing nested pages. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id is invalid, if neither document_id nor clickup_document_id is provided, if both identifiers conflict, if limit is out of range, or if cursor is malformed; NOT_FOUND if the workspace/document does not exist or any requested page_id does not exist in that document; FORBIDDEN if you lack permission to read the document/pages; and RATE_LIMITED if page retrieval exceeds quota.

document_id.description: Internal document entity id (time_and_docs.entity_id) to fetch pages from.

clickup_document_id.description: Vendor ClickUp document id to fetch pages from (alternative to document_id).

page_ids.description: Optional list of ClickUp page ids to fetch. If omitted, returns all pages in the document.

depth.description: Optional depth for nested page retrieval when returning all pages.

limit.description: Maximum number of pages to return (pagination).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to continue listing pages.

tool_schemas.name: create_document_page
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new page in the specified document (resolved by document_id or clickup_document_id) and returns the created page record including its assigned page id and placement under parent_page_id when provided. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id is invalid, if neither document_id nor clickup_document_id is provided, if both are provided but do not refer to the same document, if body.title is missing/empty, or if body fields contain unsupported values (including content_format/visibility); NOT_FOUND if the workspace/document does not exist or parent_page_id does not exist in the document; FORBIDDEN if you lack permission to add pages to the document or set the requested visibility; and RATE_LIMITED when creation exceeds quota.

document_id.description: Internal document entity id (time_and_docs.entity_id) to create the page in.

clickup_document_id.description: Vendor ClickUp document id to create the page in (alternative to document_id).

parent_page_id.description: Optional ClickUp page id to create this page under (for nested pages).

body.description: Fields used to create the document page.

tool_schemas.name: update_document_page
tool_schemas.description: Updates a document page identified by page_id or entity_id and returns the updated page record, applying content_mode=replace to overwrite content or content_mode=append to add to existing content. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id is invalid, if neither page_id nor entity_id is provided, if both are provided but refer to different pages, or if body contains unsupported values (including content_format/content_mode); NOT_FOUND if the workspace or page does not exist; FORBIDDEN if you lack permission to edit the page; and CONFLICT if the update is refused due to an invalid state transition (for example attempting to append/replace content on a page that is not editable).

page_id.description: Vendor ClickUp page id to update.

entity_id.description: Internal document page entity id (time_and_docs.entity_id) to update (alternative to page_id).

content_mode.description: Whether to replace existing content or append to it.

body.description: Fields used to update the document page.

tool_schemas.name: get_whoami
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity and entitlement snapshot for the provided credentials, including subject identifiers, granted scopes, and current rate-limit/quota consumption when available. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the credential is missing/invalid.

accessToken.description: ClickUp OAuth access token used for downstream vendor calls; when omitted, the server uses the caller's already-authenticated session if available.

metadata.name: ClickUp Task Integration Server
metadata.description: This backend models a ClickUp integration server that mirrors a workspace hierarchy (workspace→spaces→folders→lists), tasks (with tags, comments, attachments, custom fields), time tracking, and ClickUp Docs (documents and pages). Tools operate by resolving entities by id or by name within a containe
